svg.aria-label: Animated figure of the external validation in Brest: a real baseline CT slice is encoded into a latent code z; seven clinical variables and an expansion flag form a condition vector that steers a diffusion model, which denoises random noise into a predicted latent change; the change is added to z and decoded into a follow-up CT. Five illustrative simulations, some under- and some over-estimating the bleed, are drawn one by one, then turned into a voxel-wise probability map on the real follow-up CT
